race.comment: AURA (3) has been finding the line with purpose this prep and should be peaking today. Settled near the tail of a field of 14 then made significant late inroads over this course and distance three weeks ago. Handy mare who will prove tough to hold off. CRATHIE KIRK (4) caught the eye first-up over 1400m at Kembla then was in need of more ground last time at this track when she stayed at seven furlongs. Drops in grade today and finds her right race. Last start Wyong maiden winner MADE IN ITALY (8) meets a deeper field today but the manner of that breakthrough performance over 1625m was pleasing to the eye. In the money at eight of her other nine runs so she is certainly genuine. OUTTA LINE (2) is fitter for two runs back from a spell and Nash takes over which is a plus. Can do a lot better than her poor effort at Newcastle last time. Consistent mare ALADDIN'S GIRL (6) needs the mile now and is ready to peak after three runs back.
